definitions.explanation: The activity of climbing or hiking up mountains for recreation or sport.

examples.japanese: {山登|やまのぼ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{山登|やまのぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going mountain climbing this weekend.
I bought shoes for mountain climbing.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain) + ⟦{登|のぼ}り→上り：03943_nobori⟧ (climbing)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {山登|やまのぼ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (go mountain climbing)
- {山登|やまのぼ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (do mountain climbing)
- {山登|やまのぼ}り⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (~ for mountain climbing)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧ (mountaineering - more formal)
- ⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧ (hiking - loanword)
- ⟦トレッキング→トレッキング：28065_torekkingu⟧ (trekking)
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain)

Japan has many popular mountains for climbing, including ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧ (Mt. Fuji).
